topIssues.title: op-reth: batcher throttling
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
Background on batcher-sequencer throttling in our docs: https://docs.optimism.io/chain-operators/guides/configuration/batcher#batcher-sequencer-throttling

op-geth provides an endpoint `miner_setMaxDASize` to allow the batcher to throttle individual tx and full block size, as estimated by transaction DA usage. op-reth and op-rbuilder implement this endpoint already, but as a stub. It doesn't do anything.

The implementation inside op-geth can be followed at [`miner/worker.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/blob/733bb5b623f7e9682771764f3eb402292da892f4/miner/worker.go?plain=1#L498 ), `Miner.commitTransactions`. Follow the use of `blockDABytes` for the block DA limit and how `MaxDATxSize` is used in the `txpool.PendingFilter`, set at [`Miner.fillTransactions`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/blob/733bb5b623f7e9682771764f3eb402292da892f4/miner/worker.go?plain=1#L696).

topIssues.title: flaky test: `TestInteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes_FasterChainB/SuperRootInvalidIfUnsupportedByL1Data-fpp`
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
**CI run:** https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ethereum-optimism/optimism/121281/workflows/bf0bc10c-07bf-4364-9756-aaeec46fcb0b/jobs/4703060/tests

**Date:** 2026-03-31

**Error:** Kona interop program exits 0 (valid) when the test expects exit 1 (invalid claim). Same root cause as ethereum-optimism/optimism#19828.

```
Error Trace: superfaultproofs.go:169
Error:       An error is expected but got nil.
             expected: *exec.ExitError
Test:        TestInteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes_FasterChainB/SuperRootInvalidIfUnsupportedByL1Data-fpp
Messages:    expected kona interop program to fail, got: <nil>
             INFO interop_client: Successfully validated progressed transition state
             with commitment 0xf9e2f8d9...
```

**Root cause:** Same as ethereum-optimism/optimism#19828. When `endTimestamp` falls on a no-op boundary for the slower chain, kona correctly produces a valid no-op transition without needing L1 data. The test expects kona to reject `step1` because `l1HeadBefore` has no batch data, but since it's a no-op there's nothing to derive.

Encountered in the merge queue for ethereum-optimism/optimism#19814.

topPRs.title: op-node: add RPC-based executing-message validator for unsafe blocks
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Adds an optional validator hook in `EngineController.insertUnsafePayload` between `NewPayload` and `ForkchoiceUpdate`. When `--interop.rpc-overrides=chainID=URL,...` is set, every `ExecutingMessage` log in a newly-inserted unsafe block is verified against the remote chain's `eth_getLogs`.
- Intended for light-CL operators running **without op-supervisor** — a lightweight alternative to full cross-chain verification.
- Validates: log existence at `(origin, block, logIndex)`, origin address, remote-block timestamp matches `Identifier.Timestamp`, `Identifier.Timestamp ≤ exec_block.Timestamp` (temporal ordering), message expiry window (≤ `MessageExpiryTimeSecondsInterop`), and `keccak(topics || data) == payloadHash`.
- Parallel per-chain via `errgroup`; per-block retry budget (default 60s, configurable via `--interop.rpc-validator.timeout`); rejected block does not call FCU (returns `TemporaryError` from `insertUnsafePayload`). `validation_time` logged alongside `newpayload_time` / `fcu2_time`.

## Config

```
--interop.rpc-overrides=10=https://mainnet.optimism.io,8453=https://mainnet.base.org
--interop.rpc-validator.timeout=60s   # optional
```

Empty `--interop.rpc-overrides` leaves the validator disabled (no behavior change).

## Trust model

A compliant remote full node returning a log at the claimed identifier is treated as evidence that some valid state transition produced that log. Remote chain reorgs are accepted — this validator only strengthens local soundness relative to "no cross-chain check at all." Not a substitute for cross-safety.

## Files

| File | Δ | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `op-node/rollup/interop/rpc_validator.go` | new (+246) | Validator, `remoteClient` interface, `ParseRPCOverrides`, retry loop |
| `op-node/rollup/engine/engine_controller.go` | +34 | `UnsafeBlockValidator` interface, field, setter, call site, metric |
| `op-node/flags/flags.go` | +18 | Two new flags in `InteropCategory` |
| `op-node/node/node.go` | +17 | Construct validator, wire into `EngineController` |
| `op-node/rollup/interop/config.go` | +8 | `RPCOverrides` / `RPCValidatorTimeout` fields |
| `op-node/service.go` | +5 | Copy flag values into `interop.Config` |
| `op-node/rollup/interop/rpc_validator_test.go` | new (+401) | 21 unit tests |

## Test plan

- [x] `go test ./op-node/rollup/interop/...` — 21/21 pass (happy path, missing log, wrong origin, bad payload hash, timestamp inversion, expired, unknown chain, retry-then-succeed, timeout exceeded, pre-interop skip, receipts fetch error, + 9 parser cases)
- [x] `go test ./op-node/rollup/engine/...` — no regressions
- [x] `go test ./op-node/node/...` — no regressions
- [x] `go build ./...` / `go vet ./op-node/...` — clean
- [ ] Live sync test against OP Mainnet + Base with real RPC overrides (TODO — run locally)

topPRs.title: feat(op-devstack): register super dispute games via test framework (no migrate)
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #20227.

## Summary

Removes the OPCMv2.migrate step from the single-chain interop fault-proof tests by having the test framework register super dispute games directly on the `DisputeGameFactory` as the L1 PAO. Super impls already live on the shared `OPContractsManagerContainer` when the `SuperRootGamesMigration` dev flag is set at deploy, so no per-chain game deployment is needed — just pack gameArgs with `L2ChainID = 0` and call `factory.setImplementation(gameType, impl, gameArgs)`. Pattern mirrors how the migrate call is driven today.

`NewSingleChainInteropSupernodeProofs` now routes through the no-migrate super-at-genesis runtime; `TestInteropSingleChainFaultProofs` opts in to `SUPER_CANNON` and `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` via the new `presets.WithSuperGameTypeAdded(gameType, prestate)` option and passes end-to-end (16 subtests, 38s). Zero op-deployer or contract changes.

## Test plan
- [x] `TestInteropSingleChainFaultProofs` runs green locally with the migrate step removed.
- [ ] CI confirms nothing else on the shared `NewSingleChainInteropSupernodeProofs` preset regressed.

topPRs.title: feat: add SP1Adapter
topPRs.author: 0xChin
topPRs.body:
## Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Introduces the `SP1Adapter`, the first concrete implementation of `IZKVerifier`, targeting Succinct's SP1 PLONK verifier.                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  The adapter is a thin, stateless singleton (not proxied) that sits between `ZKDisputeGame` and the SP1 verifier, following the `MIPS.sol` pattern. This is necessary because the SP1 verifier is not compliant with 
  `IZKVerifier`: the adapter bridges the two interfaces without modifying the core dispute game logic.

  ## Changes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - `interfaces/vendor/ISP1Verifier.sol` — minimal vendor interface for Succinct's SP1 verifier, covering `verifyProof()` and `VERSION()`
  - `src/dispute/zk/SP1Adapter.sol` — adapter contract implementing `IZKVerifier`; `verifierType()` returns `"SP1-{VERSION}"` by reading from the underlying verifier                                                 
  - `interfaces/dispute/zk/IZKVerifier.sol` — change `verifierType()` from `pure` to `view` to allow adapters to read from external contracts                                                                         
  - `test/dispute/zk/SP1Adapter.t.sol` — 6 tests covering construction, versioning, verifier type string, proof delegation, argument forwarding, and revert propagation                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  ## Blocked on                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                  
  - #19685 `feat: opcm zk roots` — adds `zkDisputeGameImpl` to `Implementations` and wires `ZK_DISPUTE_GAME` into OPCM; once merged, `sp1AdapterImpl` will be added to `Implementations` and the `SP1Adapter` address 
  plumbed as the `verifier` in game args
  - #19912 `feat: zk opcm go` — Go-side encoding of ZK game configs in `op-deployer`; needed to deploy chains with `SP1Adapter` as the verifier                                                                       
  - #19955 `test: add ZKDisputeGame unit and integration test coverage` — once merged, SP1Adapter-specific integration tests will be added on top

topPRs.title: fix(opcm): harden Initializable slot clearing during upgrades
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- harden `OPContractsManagerUtils.upgrade()` against invalid initializer offsets and avoid clobbering the OZ v5 `_initializing` byte before it is checked
- support custom OZ v5 Initializable slots and keep the overloaded utils upgrade calls CI-safe without `abi.encodeWithSelector`
- bump `OPContractsManagerV2` semver to `7.1.17` and refresh `packages/contracts-bedrock/snapshots/semver-lock.json`

## Testing
- `FOUNDRY_DENY=never forge test --match-path test/L1/opcm/OPContractsManagerUtils.t.sol --match-test "test.*upgrade.*|test.*Initializing.*|test.*Offset.*|test.*Custom.*V5.*"`
- `FOUNDRY_PROFILE=ci go run scripts/autogen/generate-semver-lock/main.go`

## Notes
- previous failing PR checks were blocked by the overloaded `upgrade(...)` encoding in `OPContractsManagerUtilsCaller.sol` and the missing `OPContractsManagerV2` semver/lock update; both are included in this revision
